closedByA89.gap: OAuth callback state could be checked without exact intent and locale binding
closedByA89.closure: Strict callback contract binds state, intent and locale.

closedByA89.gap: Callback accepted unknown or duplicate query parameters
closedByA89.closure: Exact query allowlist rejects unknown and duplicate parameters.

closedByA89.gap: OAuth code and OTP parameters could be mixed
closedByA89.closure: Mutually exclusive callback modes fail closed.

closedByA89.gap: OTP type could be confused between recovery, email change and confirmation
closedByA89.closure: Intent-specific OTP type binding is mandatory.

closedByA89.gap: Provider error mode could coexist with success material
closedByA89.closure: Provider error, code and OTP modes are exclusive.

closedByA89.gap: Auth secrets could be reused across purposes
closedByA89.closure: Production readiness requires purpose-separated secrets.

closedByA89.gap: Trusted account headers used a historical static bearer boundary
closedByA89.closure: Request-bound HMAC replaces static bearer acceptance.

closedByA89.gap: Trusted account identity was not bound to method and path
closedByA89.closure: HMAC binds method and canonical pathname.

closedByA89.gap: Trusted header replay lacked one-time durable nonce semantics
closedByA89.closure: Timestamp plus durable one-use nonce is required.

closedByA89.gap: Raw x-velmere-account-id could be mistaken for identity
closedByA89.closure: Unsigned raw account headers never resolve an account.

closedByA89.gap: Password recovery grant was reusable inside its TTL
closedByA89.closure: Hash-only durable ledger atomically consumes grants once.

closedByA89.gap: Recovery grant signing reused broader auth-flow secrets in production
closedByA89.closure: Dedicated production recovery-grant key is required.

closedByA89.gap: Recovery grant was not durably bound to subject and session family
closedByA89.closure: Ledger binds subject fingerprint, family and expiry.

closedByA89.gap: Production-like Vercel environments could inherit development Origin exceptions
closedByA89.closure: Origin allowance checks NODE_ENV and VERCEL_ENV.

closedByA89.gap: Auth and profile bodies accepted unknown fields
closedByA89.closure: Exact object-key contracts reject mass-assignment fields.

closedByA89.gap: A base pass descendant could skip a legal patch revision of the previous base pass

closedByA89.gap: The A89 local test wrote an active fixture receipt into SOURCE_ONLY and violated the source/evidence-history separation.
closedByA89.closure: The test now writes only the compact deterministic config receipt; full execution output is retained exclusively in MATERIALS and the active fixture artifact is removed from source.

truthBoundary: A89 proves only the declared local account/auth/tenant/privacy and Trust Center intake contracts. It does not prove real OAuth, production proxy semantics, two-tenant RLS, account-takeover resistance, cross-device revocation, DSAR execution, external finding acceptance, legal approval, LIVE, sale readiness or world-class status.
